63df89c734ceadd0e4f72026f1f172bdf826c996.definition: The air is recirculated inside the car instead of being drawn in from outside. Severity level 1 — Information / Status. Action: Nothing to do. Recirculation keeps the road smell out, but it is not a fresh-air setting..
63df89c734ceadd0e4f72026f1f172bdf826c996.gloss: The air is recirculated inside the car instead of being drawn in from outside.
